meta.title: Implement retry-after header handling for improved throttling in fetch requests
meta.body_summary: Add retry-after header parsing to fetch retry logic so that throttled responses are respected instead of relying solely on exponential backoff, reducing unnecessary server load.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented retry-after header handling; bot review flagged three issues (undefined_variable, unit confusion, flaky test); pelikhan applied fixes and merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At an estimated 400 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit. The PR merged quickly after bot-flagged issues were fixed, consistent with a low-risk performance improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: GitHub Actions automated reviews identified: an undefined_variable reference in catch block, potential milliseconds/seconds unit confusion in delay calculation, and a flaky test due to timing tolerance. These were not blocking; maintainer fixed or addressed them.
review_details.performance_claim: Respecting retry-after header reduces unnecessary load on throttled services and can yield faster recovery than blind exponential backoff.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Retry-after header parsing is a well-defined HTTP feature; Copilot successfully delivered the change with unit tests, though automated review caught minor code issues that were fixed before merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: github-actions bot performed static analysis and flagged potential bugs (undefined variable, unit confusion, flaky test).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes unit tests for parseRetryAfter but no benchmark or profiler evidence for timing improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer pelikhan applied fixes after bot comments, including commenting out flaky tests and addressing the undefined variable.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/core/src/fetch.ts, added parseRetryAfter() supporting seconds and HTTP-date formats; integrated into createFetch retry logic to use server-delayed backoff when available, with logging updates. Added packages/core/test/fetch-retry-after.test.ts with vitest tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Build permissions update in later commit touched .github/workflows but not directly performance-related.

review_signals.summary: Catch block uses `errorMessage(e)` but caught variable is `e`, not `error`; will cause ReferenceError.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer likely corrected the reference (exact fix not visible but merged).

review_signals.summary: Delay calculation uses `retryAfterSeconds * 1000` with `Math.min(maxDelay, ...)`, but unit consistency between `maxDelay` and `retryAfterSeconds` should be verified.
review_signals.action_taken: Presumably reviewed by maintainer; no further comment.

review_signals.summary: Test allows ±2s tolerance for HTTP date parsing; timing-based tests can be flaky; consider mocking time.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer later commented out flaky test cases in related tests.
